site: Phillips Farms, Good Hope Church Rd
about: Phillips Farms of Cary sits at 6800 Good Hope Church Road.
The Country Christmas Walk Through Light Show opens Friday, November 27, 2026.
It runs nightly through December 27.
Evening hours are about 5 to 9 PM.
Guests follow a trail of lights across the farm grounds.
Every ticket includes a s'mores kit.
Families also visit Santa and Mrs. Klaus.
Pictures with Santa are do it yourself.
The Pint Sized Pasture Petting Zoo is part of admission.
Christmas movie clips play on a big screen by the fire.
General admission is $20 per person for ages 2 and up.

faq: When does the light show run?
Nightly from November 27 through December 27, 2026, with evening hours of about 5 to 9 PM.
Where is it?
Phillips Farms of Cary, 6800 Good Hope Church Rd, Cary, NC 27519.
How much is a ticket?
General admission is $20 per person for ages 2 and up, and SimpleTix lists $22.13 with fees.
What is included?
The light walk, a s'mores kit, a visit with Santa and Mrs. Klaus, the petting zoo and movie clips.
Can I take photos with Santa?
Yes, but pictures with Santa are do it yourself, so bring a camera.
Can I get a refund?
No, tickets are not exchangeable or refundable.
How late can I enter?
Tickets can be redeemed until 30 minutes before closing.

about: The Mary Perry Ragsdale Family YMCA is at 900 Bonner Drive in Jamestown.
Pictures with Santa happen on Saturday, December 12, 2026.
The visit runs from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM.
Photos are taken in the Energy Factory.
The event is free.
The listing gives the cost as free.
No photographer is provided.
Bring a phone or camera for your own pictures.
Santa greets kids of all ages.
The two hour window leaves time to arrive without a rush.
Jamestown sits just outside High Point.
Contact the YMCA of Greensboro for questions.
faq: When is Pictures with Santa at the Ragsdale YMCA?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM.
Where is it?
Mary Perry Ragsdale Family YMCA, 900 Bonner Dr, Jamestown, NC 27282.
Does it cost anything?
No, the event is free.
Is a photographer provided?
No, so bring your own phone or camera.
Where are the photos taken?
In the Energy Factory at the YMCA.
What ages can visit?
All ages.
Is it indoors?
Yes, the photos are taken inside the YMCA.
